source.note: From AMU Cloud (amucloud.in, now offline), a student-run site of Drive folders. B.Tech Electrical Engineering, 2nd year: Circuit Theory, Electrical Machines 1, Electrical Engineering Materials, Signals and Systems (Unit folders and 'All Material' folders). The 'All Material' folders mix in published textbooks (Hayt, Ashfaq Hussain, Haykin), which are not published here.

meta.title: Lecture 2 · Review of Fundamental Concepts
meta.summary: Handwritten class notes dated 8 August 2020 starting the Circuit Theory course with a review of fundamental concepts.

meta.title: Lecture 3 · Inductors and Capacitors
meta.summary: Slides after a review of ideal/non-ideal, active/passive and lumped/distributed elements, introducing the inductor and capacitor.

meta.title: Lecture 4 · Capacitors
meta.summary: Slides on capacitors: capacitor types such as radial/electrolytic, behaviour and basic relations, following Alexander & Sadiku.

meta.title: Lecture 5 · First Order Circuits (Source-Free RC/RL)
meta.summary: First of the first-order circuits lectures: source-free RC and RL circuits and their natural responses.

meta.title: Lecture 6 · First Order Circuits — Forced Response
meta.summary: Slides on the forced (step) response of first-order RC and RL circuits.

meta.title: Lecture 7 · First Order Circuits (Source-Free RC/RL)
meta.summary: Further slides on source-free RC/RL first-order circuits; deck header reads Lecture 7 although the file metadata says Lecture 6.

meta.title: Lecture 8 · First Order Circuits — Forced Response
meta.summary: More slides on forced response of first-order circuits with worked examples; deck metadata title still says Lecture 6.

meta.title: Lecture 9 · Second Order Circuits (Transient and Forced Response)
meta.summary: Slides on second-order RLC circuits: transient and forced response, damping cases and initial/final conditions.

meta.title: Unit 2 notes · Filters
meta.summary: Typed Unit 2 notes on wave filters: pass/stop bands, cut-off frequency, decibels and nepers, filter types, T and π sections, attenuation and phase constant.

meta.title: Filters — design formulae notes (page)
meta.summary: One handwritten notebook page on filter design: pass/stop band sketch, characteristic impedance Zo, cut-off frequency fc and formulae for L and C.

meta.title: Filters — T and π sections notes (page)
meta.summary: One handwritten notebook page on low-pass and high-pass filters in T and π sections, with Zo, fc, L, C, attenuation and phase-constant formulae.

meta.title: EEC2710 syllabus · Circuit Theory
meta.summary: Official EEC2710 (2021-scheme) Circuit Theory syllabus: credits, assessment weightings, course objectives and outcomes.

meta.title: Paramagnetism · classical treatment in the canonical ensemble
meta.summary: Slides on the classical statistical-mechanics treatment of paramagnetism: permanent magnetic moments from electron spin, canonical ensemble derivation and Curie behaviour.

meta.title: Lecture 15 · Local Electric Field
meta.summary: Local (effective) field at an atomic site, the contribution of neighbouring dipoles and the Lorentz field used to treat dielectric properties of solids and liquids.

meta.title: Dipolar relaxation and dielectric losses
meta.summary: Frequency dependence of orientational polarisation: Debye relaxation of permanent dipoles, relaxation time and the resulting dielectric losses.

meta.title: Factors affecting resistivity and electron scattering
meta.summary: Why lattice-vibration theory fails for alloys: impurity scattering, scattering cross-section and the factors that govern the resistivity of conducting materials.

meta.title: Insulating materials · properties and applications
meta.summary: Long slide deck on insulating materials: general physical, electrical, thermal, chemical and mechanical properties, and applications of plastics, natural and gaseous insulants.

meta.title: Superconductivity and electrical contact materials
meta.summary: Slides on superconductivity (Meissner effect, type I/II, BCS, Josephson junctions, SQUIDs, high-Tc materials) followed by solder, brazing and electrical contact materials.

meta.title: Course outline and introduction · free-electron theory of metals
meta.summary: Opening lecture of APS2050: course number, credits, assessment and outcomes, reference books, then classification of materials by resistivity and the Drude free-electron model.

meta.title: Behaviour of dielectrics in alternating fields
meta.summary: Electronic polarisability and its frequency dependence, dielectric constant and losses of materials in alternating fields.

meta.title: Magnetic properties of materials
meta.summary: Short slide set on measuring magnetic properties, the atomic origins of magnetism, applied field and induction, susceptibility and classification of magnetic materials.

meta.title: Dielectric constant of polyatomic molecules
meta.summary: Notes on the dielectric constant of polyatomic molecules: temperature dependence, electronegativity of bonded atoms and molecular dipole moments.

meta.title: Question bank · numericals on magnetic properties
meta.summary: Set of practice numericals on magnetic materials: magnetisation, susceptibility, Curie law and Weiss field, plus a question on Langevin theory of paramagnetism.

meta.title: Transformer oil · testing and analysis
meta.summary: Slides on transformer oil: chemistry and composition, ageing, dielectric and degradation diagnostics and oil testing parameters.

meta.title: Class notes · magnetic properties of materials
meta.summary: Handwritten notes on magnetism in materials: magnetization, permeability and susceptibility, domains and hysteresis, ferro-, ferri- and paramagnetism.

meta.title: Physical constants chart
meta.summary: One-page chart of physical constants (speed of light, Planck, Boltzmann, electron charge and mass, and others) used in the course.

meta.title: APS2050 syllabus (old scheme)
meta.summary: Official APS2050 Electrical Engineering Materials course outline approved by the B.O.S. in 2018, with units 1-4 and the reference books.

meta.title: Unit 1 notes · conductivity and free electron theory
meta.summary: Handwritten Unit 1 notes: resistivity of conductors, semiconductors and insulators, Drude model and its assumptions, relaxation time and conductivity.

meta.title: Unit 3 notes · insulating materials and their applications
meta.summary: Handwritten Unit 3 notes on insulating materials: required characteristics, classification by substance and temperature, solid, liquid and gaseous insulators.

meta.title: Unit 4 notes · magnetic properties of materials
meta.summary: Handwritten Unit 4 notes: magnetization and susceptibility, atomic origin of magnetism, para-, ferro-, antiferro- and ferrimagnetism, ferrites, domains and hysteresis.

meta.title: Slides · ideal transformer
meta.summary: Short slide set on the ideal transformer, prepared as Electrical Machines-1 class material with reference to P.S. Bimbhra.

meta.title: Induction motors · lectures 1-16
meta.summary: Printed lecture notes IM 01-16 on three-phase induction motors: rotating field, revolving-field theory, windings and rotors, equivalent circuit, torque and slip characteristics, no-load, blocked-rotor and circle diagram.

meta.title: Induction motors · lectures 17-29
meta.summary: Printed lecture notes IM 17-29: starting methods, speed control (stator voltage, frequency, pole changing, rotor resistance, slip-power recovery) and harmonic torques, skewing and slot harmonics.

meta.title: Slides · operation and types of transformer
meta.summary: Slide set on how a transformer works and the types of transformers, prepared as Electrical Machines class material with reference to P.S. Bimbhra.

meta.title: Transformers notes · Lectures 1–14
meta.summary: Handwritten notes for fourteen lectures on transformers: construction and types, equivalent circuit, losses, tests, efficiency, regulation, switching transients, auto-transformers, parallel operation, open-delta and Scot

meta.title: Unit 2 notes · Parallel operation of transformers (Lectures 12A–12C)
meta.summary: Handwritten notes on parallel operation of transformers: reasons for paralleling, no-load circulating current, essential conditions and load sharing.

meta.title: EEC2110 syllabus · Electrical Machines – I
meta.summary: Official course outline for EEC2110 Electrical Machines – I: objectives, outcomes, unit-wise syllabus (transformers, induction machines) and suggested reading.

meta.title: Signals and Systems · full course slides
meta.summary: Lecture slides for the whole ELC2410 Signals and Systems course: signal representation and classification, time-domain analysis, convolution, Fourier, Laplace and z-transform material.

meta.title: Tutorial 1 · 2021-22
meta.summary: Tutorial sheet 1 on complex numbers, Euler's formula, polar form and sketching of signals.

meta.title: Tutorial · Unit 2 problems
meta.summary: Tutorial sheet on time-domain analysis: superposition, discrete- and continuous-time convolution, and block-diagram realisation of difference equations.

meta.title: Unit 1 notes · Introduction to Signals and Systems (Part 1)
meta.summary: Typed notes introducing signals and systems: definitions, classification of continuous- and discrete-time signals, basic operations and system properties.

meta.title: Unit 1 notes · Ramp function and system classification (Part 2)
meta.summary: Typed notes continuing Unit 1: ramp and impulse functions, and the representation and classification of continuous- and discrete-time systems.

meta.title: Unit 2 notes · Time-domain analysis (Part 1)
meta.summary: Typed notes on time-domain analysis of LTI systems: decomposition into basic signals, delayed impulses, convolution and complex exponentials.

meta.title: Unit 2 notes · Convolution integral and LTI properties (Part 2)
meta.summary: Typed notes continuing Unit 2: worked convolution integral with interval overlap, and properties of linear time-invariant systems.
